{"cmd": "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess
cards=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
for start in range(0,8,8):
 args=['magick','montage','-font','Helvetica']
 for c in cards[start:start+8]:
  args+=['(',c['crop'],'-filter','point','-resize','400%',')']
 args+=['-tile','1x','-geometry','+12+16','-background','white',f'zoom/group{start//8+1:02}.png']
 subprocess.run(args,check=True)
print(len(cards))
PY"}
